content: {"paper_id":"W2904398352","annotations":[{"keyword_id":"multi-label-learning","exact_quote":"a novel Partial Multi-label Learning (PML) framework is proposed to cope with such problem, i.e. removing the the noisy labels from the multi-label sets.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"论文提出部分多标记学习框架，处理多标记集合，属于多标记学习任务。"},{"keyword_id":"noisy-label-learning","exact_quote":"removing the the noisy labels from the multi-label sets","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"监督标签集合含冗余噪声，论文以去除多标记集合中的噪声标签为研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"weakly-supervised-learning","exact_quote":"the labeling information for multi-label data is always redundant , which can not be solved by classical MLL methods","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"标注信息冗余、不精确，监督条件不充分且被作为待解决的研究问题。"},{"keyword_id":"low-rank-modeling","exact_quote":"we first reformulate the observed label set into a label matrix, and then decompose it into a groundtruth label matrix and an irrelevant label matrix, where the former is constrained to be low rank and the latter is assumed to be sparse.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"显式对真值标签矩阵施加低秩约束，属于低秩建模。"},{"keyword_id":"label-correlation-modeling","exact_quote":"we utilize the feature mapping matrix to explore the label correlations and meanwhile constrain the feature mapping matrix to be low rank to prevent the proposed method from being overfitting.","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"通过特征映射矩阵显式探索标签相关性。"},{"keyword_id":"data-imputation-recovery","exact_quote":"we first reformulate the observed label set into a label matrix, and then decompose it into a groundtruth label matrix and an irrelevant label matrix","evidence_field":"abstract","reason_zh":"从含冗余噪声的观测标签矩阵分解恢复真值标签矩阵，输出为恢复后的标签数据。"}],"abstentions":[],"input_issues":[]}
